amendment_history.note: الإصدار الأصلي (15 مادة، بلا تقسيم إلى أبواب أو فصول) -- الموافقة على إنشاء هيئة باسم (هيئة التأمين) وفقاً لتنظيمها المرافق، نُشر التنظيم والقرار المرافق له في عدد جريدة أم القرى رقم (4995) الصادر في 25 أغسطس 2023م، ويعمل بالتنظيم بعد تسعين يوماً من تاريخ نشره (م15). لا توجد تعديلات لاحقة معروفة على نص التنظيم ذاته حتى تاريخ هذه الجولة البحثية (انظر known_unresolved_discrepancies).

chapter_structure.label_ar: بدون تقسيم إلى أبواب أو فصول
chapter_structure.title_ar: مواد متسلسلة غير مجمعة تحت أبواب أو فصول رسمية، لا يحمل أي منها عنواناً فرعياً في المصدر: التعريفات (م1) -- الشخصية الاعتبارية والاستقلال المالي والإداري والارتباط برئيس مجلس الوزراء ومقر الهيئة (م2) -- أهداف الهيئة (م3) -- اختصاصات الهيئة العامة (م4) -- تشكيل مجلس الإدارة (م5) -- اختصاصات المجلس (م6) -- اجتماعات المجلس وقراراته (م7) -- الرئيس التنفيذي واختصاصاته (م8) -- موارد الهيئة المالية (م9) -- الميزانية والسنة المالية (م10) -- رفع الحساب الختامي إلى رئيس مجلس الوزراء (م11) -- مراجع الحسابات الخارجي ورقابة الديوان العام للمحاسبة (م12) -- التقرير السنوي (م13) -- خضوع منسوبي الهيئة لنظامي العمل والتأمينات الاجتماعية (م14) -- النشر والنفاذ (م15).

verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE ACCESS: laws.boe.gov.sa's live portal (the exact URL researched in a prior pass, https://laws.boe.gov.sa/BoeLaws/Laws/LawDetails/6994e763-5a47-4c4e-b796-b08000dccc7d/1) was UNREACHABLE this pass -- every direct curl attempt through this environment's egress proxy failed with 'Recv failure: Connection reset by peer' during the TLS handshake (consistent with the prior pass's HTTP 503 finding). The Wayback Machine's own availability API (archive.org/wayback/available, a DIFFERENT host from web.archive.org) confirmed a snapshot exists for this exact BOE URL (timestamp 20260209124209), but this environment's egress policy resets every TLS connection to web.archive.org itself (the host that actually serves snapshot content) at the ClientHello stage -- confirmed via curl -v showing the CONNECT tunnel succeeds but the subsequent TLS handshake to web.archive.org:443 is reset every time, across multiple retries and both HTTP and HTTPS forms -- so the archived BOE page's actual HTML could NOT be retrieved this pass despite being known to exist. This is an environment-level reachability gap, not a finding that BOE's content differs from other sources.

GOVERNING PRIMARY SOURCE USED INSTEAD: uqn.gov.sa -- the official Umm Al-Qura Gazette portal itself (arguably an even more authoritative primary source than BOE's own compiled-law database, since Umm Al-Qura is the Kingdom's actual official gazette of record) -- was LIVE-REACHABLE this pass via direct curl (HTTP 200, after a 301 redirect from uqn.gov.sa to www.uqn.gov.sa) for BOTH: (1) https://uqn.gov.sa/details?p=23533, titled 'تنظيم هيئة التأمين', containing the full verbatim text of all 15 articles of the organizing statute; and (2) https://portal.uqn.gov.sa/details?p=23532 (redirecting likewise to www.uqn.gov.sa), titled 'الموافقة على إنشاء هيئة باسم (هيئة التأمين)', containing the full verbatim text of the COMPANION Council of Ministers Resolution No. 85 itself (13 numbered decisions, أولاً through ثالث عشر -- NOT numbered مواد; this is the enacting resolution, distinct from the attached statute). Both pages explicitly display the gazette issue's own publication date as '1445-2-09 الموافق 25-08-2023', and the resolution page additionally displays the resolution's own issuance date explicitly as 'قرار رقم (85) وتاريخ 28 /01 /1445هـ' -- confirming the exact decree number and Hijri date stated in this track's own task brief. This track treats uqn.gov.sa's text as the governing PRIMARY text for all 15 articles.

INDEPENDENT SECONDARY CROSS-CHECK (qanoonsa.com, BYTE-LEVEL): qanoonsa.com, an independent Saudi legal aggregator, was fetched live this pass via direct curl (HTTP 200) for both its companion pages: https://qanoonsa.com/p/499501/ (the Resolution) and https://qanoonsa.com/p/499502/ (the organizing statute, reached via the first page's own 'next post' navigation link, confirming the two documents' pairing independently of uqn.gov.sa). A programmatic line-level diff (difflib.SequenceMatcher) between the two sites' extracted statute text found the ONLY differences across all 15 articles to be: (a) Western-Arabic digit style ('1','2','3'...) on uqn.gov.sa versus Eastern Arabic-Indic digit style ('١','٢','٣'...) on qanoonsa.com for numbered sub-items -- a cosmetic font/rendering choice, not a textual difference; (b) one list-marker letter rendered 'هـ-' (with tatweel) on uqn.gov.sa versus 'ه-' (without tatweel) on qanoonsa.com in Article 9's sub-item (5) -- again cosmetic; and (c) trailing colons after 'المادة X' headers present on uqn.gov.sa but absent on qanoonsa.com (a formatting-only difference, whitespace-normalized away in this track's own number_label_ar field). Every substantive word of every one of the 15 articles' operative text is IDENTICAL across both independently-fetched sites.

THIRD INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION (argaam.com, QUOTE-LEVEL): argaam.com, a Saudi financial-news portal, was fetched this pass and independently confirms 15 total articles, the 90-day post-publication effective-date clause (Article 15), and quotes Articles 2, 3, 5, and 15 with wording matching uqn.gov.sa and qanoonsa.com verbatim in every quoted excerpt.

COMPANION RESOLUTION'S OWN INTERNAL CROSS-REFERENCES CONFIRM ARTICLE NUMBERING: the companion Resolution (also read via uqn.gov.sa and qanoonsa.com) itself cross-references three specific statute provisions by number, each of which independently matches this track's own ingested article text: item 'سادساً' references 'المادة (الخامسة) من التنظيم' for board-member nomination -- matching Article 5's own board-appointment text; item 'سابعاً' references 'الفقرة (2) من المادة (العاشرة)' for the first fiscal year's override -- matching Article 10's own paragraph (2), 'السنة المالية للهيئة هي السنة المالية للدولة'; and item 'ثامناً' references 'الفقرة (12) من المادة (السادسة)' for the Board's fee-setting power -- matching Article 6's own paragraph (12), 'تحديد المقابل المالي للخدمات والأعمال التي تقدمها الهيئة في مجال اختصاصاتها'. This three-way internal consistency check, all confirmed independently of any single source, corroborates that this track's ingested 15-article numbering and text are correctly paired with the resolution that enacted them.

RESOLUTION DATE ANOMALY ON qanoonsa.com, RESOLVED: qanoonsa.com's own page for the COMPANION RESOLUTION (not the statute) displays the resolution's issuance date as 'صدر في: 28 / 12 / 1444هـ الموافق: 16 / 7 / 2023م' -- but this is chronologically IMPOSSIBLE, since the very same page's own preamble cites 'توصية اللجنة العامة لمجلس الوزراء رقم (1026) وتاريخ 27 /1 /1445هـ' (a General Committee of the Council of Ministers recommendation dated 27/1/1445H) as one of the matters considered before the resolution -- a date roughly seven months AFTER qanoonsa's own stated '28/12/1444H' issuance date, meaning the resolution cannot have been issued before its own cited preamble recommendation. uqn.gov.sa's OWN page for the same resolution instead explicitly states 'قرار رقم (85) وتاريخ 28 /01 /1445هـ' -- ONE DAY after that same 27/1/1445H committee recommendation, which is chronologically consistent. This track therefore treats 28/1/1445H (per uqn.gov.sa and this track's own task brief) as the confirmed decree date, and flags qanoonsa.com's '28/12/1444H' figure as an isolated transcription error on that one site (see known_unresolved_discrepancies).

ia.gov.sa (THE AUTHORITY'S OWN SITE) -- REACHABLE, NO FULL STATUTE TEXT: ia.gov.sa was live-reachable this pass (HTTP 200 for its homepage, /ar/about-ia, and /ar/regulations-and-licenses pages, fetched via direct curl and WebFetch). None of these pages' retrievable static content hosts the founding statute's full article text: '/ar/regulations-and-licenses' lists operational/licensing regulations issued BY the Authority under its own statute (e.g. capital-requirement and investment-rules decisions), not the founding statute itself; the 'about'/organizational-structure pages do not quote the founding resolution number, date, or article text in accessible static HTML (likely rendered via authenticated/dynamic components not present in a plain fetch). ia.gov.sa was therefore NOT used as a source for this track's article text, only corroborated as reachable and consistent in general subject matter.

STRUCTURE: this statute has NO أبواب/فصول (parts/chapters) -- a flat sequence of 15 individually-numbered مواد, confirmed identically on both uqn.gov.sa and qanoonsa.com (no باب/فصل-prefixed heading found on either site). No article carries an inline topic title beyond the bare ordinal heading ('المادة الأولى:' etc.) on either site -- consistent with this corpus's tvtc_organizational_statute/saudi_engineers_law/awqaf_law precedent for sources lacking inline per-article titles; no title_ar key is used.

NO REPEAL/PREDECESSOR CLAUSE IN THE STATUTE ITSELF: unlike this corpus's tvtc_organizational_statute track (whose Article 12 explicitly names and repeals a predecessor instrument), this statute's own 15 articles contain NO express repeal or succession clause. The actual transfer of insurance-sector competencies away from SAMA and the Council of Cooperative Health Insurance is effected entirely through the COMPANION Resolution's own numbered decisions (ثانياً, رابعاً, etc.), which are NOT part of this track's ingested 'law' content (per this corpus's tvtc/etec precedent of ingesting only the attached تنظيم's own numbered مواد under law_component='law', not the enacting قرار's own preambular/procedural decisions) -- see known_unresolved_discrepancies for a full account of what those companion-resolution decisions provide.

NO AMENDMENTS FOUND THIS PASS: a search for any subsequent Council of Ministers resolution amending this organizing statute (as distinct from the Authority's own subordinate regulatory decisions made BY it under Articles 6/8's own delegated powers, e.g. Board Decision No. 144/2025 amending minimum capital-requirement rules, or No. 2/2025 and No. 15/2025 on investment and licensing rules -- all lower-tier regulatory instruments, not amendments to this statute) returned no result. Not exhaustively proven absent -- flagged per this corpus's 1-2-verification-attempts-per-fact policy.

No legal text is altered beyond whitespace normalization needed to render each site's HTML as plain text (collapsing incidental line-wrap breaks; removing trailing colons from number_label_ar's own separately-held field while leaving them in the header where the source itself supplies them) and normalizing to uqn.gov.sa's own Western-digit rendering as the single governing PRIMARY source's digit style throughout (qanoonsa.com's Eastern Arabic-Indic digit variant is cosmetic only and is not separately preserved). Arabic governs; no translation/paraphrase/interpretation performed on the Arabic text (English descriptions in this note and in document_en/issuing_authority_en are for indexing only). Read-only over input; deterministic over outputs.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: laws.boe.gov.sa's live portal (https://laws.boe.gov.sa/BoeLaws/Laws/LawDetails/6994e763-5a47-4c4e-b796-b08000dccc7d/1, the exact URL identified in a prior research pass) was unreachable this pass -- every direct curl attempt through this environment's egress proxy failed with 'Recv failure: Connection reset by peer' during the TLS handshake, consistent with the prior pass's HTTP 503 finding. The Wayback Machine's own availability API (a DIFFERENT host, archive.org, reachable this pass) confirmed an archived snapshot of this exact URL exists (timestamp 20260209124209), but this environment's egress policy resets every TLS connection to web.archive.org itself (the host that actually serves snapshot HTML) at the ClientHello stage, confirmed via curl -v across multiple retries and both HTTP/HTTPS forms -- so the archived BOE page's content could not be retrieved this pass despite being known to exist. This is an environment-level reachability gap specific to this build pass, not a finding that BOE's text differs from the governing uqn.gov.sa text used by this track.

Given BOE's own unreachability (live and via Wayback), this track uses uqn.gov.sa -- the official Umm Al-Qura Gazette portal itself -- as its governing PRIMARY source, live-fetched this pass (HTTP 200) for both the organizing statute's full 15-article text (uqn.gov.sa/details?p=23533) and its companion Council of Ministers Resolution No. 85 text (portal.uqn.gov.sa/details?p=23532, redirecting to www.uqn.gov.sa). Umm Al-Qura is the Kingdom's actual constitutional gazette of record -- arguably a stronger primary source for this purpose than BOE's own compiled-law database. This is a positive finding, not a gap, but it means this track's classification rests on ONE reached official/primary source (uqn.gov.sa) cross-verified against independent secondary aggregators (qanoonsa.com, argaam.com), rather than two independent OFFICIAL sources agreeing -- TIER_2_PRIMARY_SECONDARY_CROSS_VERIFIED, not TIER_1, per this corpus's verification-tier taxonomy.

qanoonsa.com (an independent Saudi legal aggregator) was fetched live this pass (HTTP 200) for both its companion pages -- qanoonsa.com/p/499501/ (the Resolution) and qanoonsa.com/p/499502/ (the organizing statute, reached via the first page's own 'next post' navigation link). A programmatic line-level diff (difflib.SequenceMatcher) between qanoonsa.com's and uqn.gov.sa's extracted statute text found the ONLY differences across all 15 articles to be cosmetic: Western-Arabic versus Eastern Arabic-Indic digit style for numbered sub-items, one list-marker letter rendered with versus without a tatweel ('هـ-' vs 'ه-') in Article 9's sub-item (5), and the presence versus absence of a trailing colon after 'المادة X' headers. Every substantive word of every one of the 15 articles' operative text is IDENTICAL across both independently-fetched sites.

argaam.com (a Saudi financial-news portal) was fetched this pass and independently confirms 15 total articles, the 90-day post-publication effective-date clause (Article 15), and quotes Articles 2, 3, 5, and 15 with wording matching uqn.gov.sa and qanoonsa.com verbatim in every quoted excerpt -- a third independent corroboration.

qanoonsa.com's own page for the COMPANION RESOLUTION (not the statute) displays the resolution's issuance date as 'صدر في: 28 / 12 / 1444هـ الموافق: 16 / 7 / 2023م' -- but this is chronologically impossible, since the very same page's own preamble cites 'توصية اللجنة العامة لمجلس الوزراء رقم (1026) وتاريخ 27 /1 /1445هـ' (a committee recommendation dated roughly seven months AFTER qanoonsa's own stated issuance date) as one of the matters the resolution itself considered before being issued. uqn.gov.sa's own page for the same resolution instead explicitly states 'قرار رقم (85) وتاريخ 28 /01 /1445هـ' -- one day after that same 27/1/1445H committee recommendation, which is chronologically consistent and matches this track's own task brief and independent WebSearch aggregations. This track treats 28/1/1445H as the confirmed decree date and flags qanoonsa.com's '28/12/1444H' figure as an isolated transcription error on that one site, not a genuine dating dispute.

ia.gov.sa (the Insurance Authority's own official website) was live-reachable this pass (HTTP 200) for its homepage, /ar/about-ia, and /ar/regulations-and-licenses pages. None of these pages' retrievable static content hosts the founding statute's full article text: the 'regulations' section lists operational/licensing regulations issued BY the Authority under its own statute (capital-requirement rules, investment rules, licensing rules), not the founding statute itself; the about/organizational-structure pages do not quote the founding resolution's number, date, or article text in accessible static HTML. ia.gov.sa was not used as a source for this track's article text.

This statute has NO أبواب (parts) or فصول (chapters) -- a flat sequence of 15 individually-numbered مواد, confirmed identically on both uqn.gov.sa and qanoonsa.com (no باب/فصل-prefixed heading found on either site). This track's chapter_structure field reflects this verified flat structure (a single leaf range 1-15) rather than inventing a topical grouping not present in the source.

Neither uqn.gov.sa nor qanoonsa.com supplies inline title text for any of the 15 articles -- every article heading is a bare ordinal ('المادة الأولى:' etc.) with no descriptive title. Consistent with this corpus's tvtc_organizational_statute/saudi_engineers_law/awqaf_law precedent for sources lacking inline per-article titles, no title_ar key is used for any article.

Unlike this corpus's tvtc_organizational_statute track (whose Article 12 explicitly names and repeals a predecessor instrument), this statute's own 15 articles contain NO express repeal or succession clause naming a predecessor law. The actual transfer of insurance-sector regulatory competencies away from the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) and the Council of Cooperative Health Insurance is instead effected entirely through the COMPANION Council of Ministers Resolution's own numbered decisions (particularly ثانياً and رابعاً), which state that the Authority assumes all insurance-sector competencies and responsibilities under the Cooperative Health Insurance Law (Royal Decree M/10, 1/5/1420H) and the Cooperative Insurance Companies Control Law (Royal Decree M/32, 2/6/1424H), while those two predecessor systems and their existing implementing regulations REMAIN IN FORCE pending completion of a unified Insurance Law (نظام التأمين) still in the legislative pipeline as of this resolution. Both predecessor systems are already separately ingested in this corpus as their own tracks (insurance_control, cooperative_health_insurance) and are not re-ingested here; the companion resolution's own 13 numbered decisions themselves are also not ingested as part of this 'law' track, consistent with this corpus's tvtc/etec precedent of ingesting only the attached تنظيم's own numbered مواد under law_component='law', not the enacting قرار's own preambular/procedural decisions.

Per this track's task brief and independent secondary sources (not independently re-confirmed against Umm Al-Qura this pass), health-insurance oversight was further transferred from the Council of Cooperative Health Insurance to the Insurance Authority effective on or about 4 March 2024G. This is flagged here as a separate SUBSEQUENT administrative action, not a textual amendment to any of this statute's 15 articles -- no source found this pass indicates the statute's own article text was amended in connection with that transfer, so no amendment_history entry is recorded for it.

A search for any subsequent Council of Ministers resolution amending this organizing statute's own article text (as distinct from the Authority's own subordinate regulatory decisions made BY it under Articles 6/8's delegated powers, e.g. Board Decision No. 144/2025 amending minimum capital-requirement rules for insurance companies, or Decisions No. 2/2025 and No. 15/2025 on investment and licensing rules -- all lower-tier regulatory instruments issued under this statute, not amendments to it) returned no result this pass. Not exhaustively proven absent -- flagged per this corpus's 1-2-verification-attempts-per-fact policy; a future pass with working BOE access should re-confirm no amendment exists.
